chunks: Moses said: Do you say of the truth, after it has come to you, 'Is this magic?' And the sorcerers do not prosper.
ai.seo_question: What did Moses say to the people of Pharaoh regarding their claim that the truth was magic?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Yunus, Prophet Moses (peace be upon him) confronts the Egyptian court's dismissal of divine revelation as 'magic,' asserting the ultimate futility of sorcerers. Shia scholarly tradition highlights this as a paradigm for distinguishing between superficial, transient worldly power and enduring, authentic divine truth, emphasizing that true success lies in adherence to the core message rather than mere spectacle.
